title: So the past two nights/mornings have gotten wierd.
content: I was at one of the various beach worlds ive visited but myself where underwater thinking we were gonna drown unable to move until we figured out we couldnt drown and just walked out. Somehow i made it to the school i used to see often, when i tried to enter the locker room which is typically one of those push only type of doors, now had a knob and was locked. Other things happened but i cant really remember, maybe i was chased out? Some of the dreams bled into the next nights sleep so i cant really remember at which point started the next nights dream. But we made it to an older house ive been to before in dreams there was at least 6 or more other people but at some point we had gotten information jason vorhees was going to be sent after us. We prepped somebody gave me a gun with ammo and we waited till night fall. Next thing i know a female was stabbed at the stairwell and he was in the house. Seemingly only coming for me. I tried to jump off the front or back balcony, not sure on its position only certain that it was outside of the house. He tried to hang me from the deck but it wasnt working then tried to stab me and i managed to get free and just jumped to the ground. The person after me didnt look like him from the movies and ive never even watched the original movies. No hockey mask no nothing this was just some crazed man hell bent on getting to me.
